subject.why: The fiddle and bow are instantly recognizable, complete with all standard components and the red ribbon charming detail.

category.why: The fiddle floats at a three-quarter tilt in Category 1 style over a smooth green background with concentric rings.

clean.why: There are no text, UI elements, borders, watermarks, or characters.

framing.why: The instrument and bow are centered with comfortable margins on all sides and a clear, readable silhouette.

colour.why: The warm honey-wood tones and red ribbon pop cleanly against the bright, saturated green concentric-ring background.

detail.why: Features are cleanly simplified without micro-textures, harsh wood grain, or busy clutter.

style.why: The smooth, chunky 3D volumes and soft satin sheen match the casual mobile art style of the reference images.

bg_colour.why: background is green (100% of the background); planned green
